prediction_text: Direction: Labour under Keir Starmer wins the UK general election of 4 July 2024, defeating Rishi Sunak's Conservatives by a wide margin (a landslide-scale Labour victory). Timing: election day 4 July 2024 (event date on card).
basis:
tradition: no tradition field on card (noted as absent); decided from genre — western astrology (Jessica Adams, post of 18 June 2024).
systems_used: western astrology (mundane). Card faces: snap election called 22 May for 4 July; Labour leads by roughly twenty points; Sunak damaged by the D-Day memorial early-departure episode; election falls in the Sun sign Cancer. A twenty-point sustained lead is a decisive fact-face; the Cancer-season timing face (home/nation mood turning to the opposition's care-and-home themes) concurs rather than reverses. Faces: main face = winner (Labour/Starmer); margin face = large (polling face supports 'wide', stated as landslide-scale tendency, not a seat number — no seat count invented). No anchor reversal applicable. R61-REV1: event-date timing; granularity: margin item has 1 pointer (poll gap) — expressed as scale tendency, not a number, per granularity rule.
